name: College Prep Institute (CPI)
what_you_do: Spend two weeks in a residential program on a college campus. You work on SAT prep and career growth. You also work on resume writing, college applications and admission, and leadership.
who_can_apply: Female high school students who are ready to start exploring college. Parent or guardian permission is required.
pay_detail: $3,150 per session (the page says cost is subject to change)
duration: 2 weeks, residential. Session 1: June 5 to 18, 2027. Session 2: July 2 to 17, 2027.
deadline_text: Applications open Jan 29, 2027 and close Mar 29, 2027. No late submissions accepted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the Summer Programs Interest Form now for news. Then apply in the online portal when it opens Jan 29, 2027.
notes: Costs money. Applying is not an application to Spelman and does not promise admission. The Mar 29 closing date is on the main summer programs page; the CPI page itself says only that late submissions are not accepted.
